title: Framing Audit as Argument Auditor Extension
summary: The argument auditor gains a second section, the framing audit: what alternative framings did the evidence support, what truths were available but not featured, what would change if the dominant framing were inverted. A Content Selection check on the negative space, run in the same isolated dispatch.

links.note: ADR-100 rule 4: framing-class findings are never silently resolved by pre-triage; they reach the presentation with the analysis done
